The 2026 Aotearoa Music Awards is the annual ceremony featuring awards for New Zealand music recording artists. The ceremony is set to take place on 28 May 2026 at the Civic Theatre in Auckland.
The awards will be live streamed by Radio New Zealand.
Nominees and winners
The finalists for the awards were announced on 16 April 2026. Marlon Williams leads the nominations, with seven.
